title: Share your error
subtitle: Easy log submission
description: Just copy and paste your error message or code. BugSense cleans up the mess and finds the real problem for you.
tips: Try pasting the whole terminal output—it's okay if it's messy!
marker: Paste your code here to start.

title: AI checks the code
subtitle: Fast analysis
description: Our AI (Gemma 3) reads your error and explains exactly what's going wrong in plain English.
tips: Wait a few seconds for the AI to finish thinking.
marker: The AI is now reading your error.

title: Get the fix
subtitle: Helpful breakdown
description: Instead of just code, you'll get a simple explanation of why the error happened and how to fix it forever.
tips: Ask 'Why?' to learn how to avoid this bug next time.
marker: Follow these steps to solve the bug.

title: Confirm it's fixed
subtitle: Save your solution
description: Once you've fixed the bug, write a short note about it. This helps you remember the solution later.
tips: You can share your fix to help other developers too.

title: Grow your library
subtitle: All fixes in one place
description: Every fix you save is turned into a beautiful guide in your personal library. Searchable and always ready.
tips: Use the search bar to find old fixes in seconds.
marker: Your new fix is now in the library.
